sources.title: Visa-on-Arrival in Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: Bangladesh Police's live Special Branch service says tourists from European countries may obtain a visa on arrival at Dhaka; Liechtenstein is a European sovereign state.
sources.supportingExcerpt: People from the following categories in European countries may obtain a Visa on Arrival ... Tourists.

policies.title: Liechtenstein ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board table expressly states that Liechtenstein visitors can obtain a paid visa on arrival.
conditions: The official table lists a 40-JOD arrival visa for Liechtenstein; its visitor guidance also requires Gateway2Jordan QR registration before departure.
Passport validity, purpose, permitted ports, security screening and final admission remain applicable; work, residence and special documents are outside scope.

policies.title: Liechtenstein ordinary passports: Ukraine short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Ukraine's current legislative record expressly establishes visa-free entry and transit for Liechtenstein citizens for stays not exceeding 90 days.
conditions: The decree covers entry and transit by Liechtenstein citizens for a stay not exceeding 90 days.
This is an ordinary short-visitor baseline, not work, residence, humanitarian, military, special-document or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Liechtenstein ordinary passports: Bangladesh arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Bangladesh's Special Branch makes tourists from European countries eligible to obtain a visa on arrival at Dhaka; this includes Liechtenstein ordinary-passport holders.
conditions: This is the European-country tourist category for a single-entry arrival visa at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka, for a maximum of 30 days.
Complete the official online application and acknowledgement before travel, carry the stated passport, return-ticket, funds and fee evidence, and present the acknowledgement at airport immigration.
The immigration officer grants the visa after reviewing compliance; work, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Bangladesh Visa on Arrival application portal
steps: Create an account and complete the official arrival-visa application before travel.
Review the official conditions and retain the application acknowledgement.
Present the acknowledgement and required documents at Dhaka airport for border issuance.
